censoring: refusal, max_tokens, budget caps and stopping without submit are censored and reported apart from model outcomes
interpretation: Development diagnostic: one attempt per fork for one bare model in model mode, on one synthetic parent, under a hard $5 cap. It supports no pass^k, reliability, ranking, difficulty or novelty claim, and says nothing about any vendor's system. Its purpose is to show whether LoanWorld produces non-ceiling, non-floor behavior for a frontier model and what an episode costs.
stopping_rule: Start the next fork only if remaining budget >= 1.2 x the most expensive episode so far; a per-request worst-case guard keeps total spend <= cap.
